//: Conclave configuration. Each provider maps to an installed CLI adapter.
//model: Leave model null to use each CLI's default (your logged-in subscription's model).

providers.//cloud: Free cloud models via OpenCode Zen — no install, no API keys.

//roles: Who plays what. council = brainstorm/critique panel. builders/verifiers = pools used by M2 divide-and-conquer (parallel). builder/verifier = the single-provider M1 fallback.

loop.//parallelBuild: true = M2: split into sub-tasks, build in parallel git worktrees, cross-verify, merge. false = M1: single builder.
